label: Data Layer
title: Data Layer
subtitle: Manages a shared reactive key-value store that all agents can read and write. Properties can be watched for changes and subscribed to, enabling real-time coordination between the agents in a project.
whenToUse: Use when multiple agents need to share structured state, or when you want one agent to react automatically as another produces results.

methods.name: Set Property
methods.description: Sets a named property to a value, which subscribed agents pick up on their next reasoning step.

methods.name: Get Property
methods.description: Retrieves a named property from the data layer.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the agent to a property so its value is automatically injected into context on every turn.

methods.name: Watch Source
methods.description: Watches a file or URL and automatically updates a property whenever the source changes.

methods.name: List Properties
methods.description: Returns all current properties and active watchers.

mediaCaption: A walkthrough of the data layer in a project: the Project Overview and its Scratchpad, the typed properties agents share, and watchers that keep a property in sync with a file or a URL
